title: Bound the optional panorama's actual software WebGL work outside primary paint

scope.subject: Isolate software-only DeepSky decode/upload from primary Galaxy-System-Approach and carried renderer work; reuse original asset and actual paint authority.

research_summary: Exact GitHub run 45865051013 shard2 archived traces show requests reaching System2 before applied pose (1.392109) and late actual Approach, or legitimate Atmosphere4 still mid-animation under global slow renderer. The already proven System painted handoff fixes spare RAF, not these prior late frames. Direct same frozen route and true mouse instrumentation saw 8192×4096 HTMLImageElement uploads from hidden DeepSky phase System at 1.27s unloaded, 1.94s CPU3, and 3.26s CPU5 synthetic; a 4K shadow reduces aggregate load but not all route timing. Bounded 4096×2048 software decode via installed loader, preserving orientation and same asset without eager GPU upload, keeps zero GL sky work before active world and retains calculated fallback/foreground readiness, targets, input and timing. Cannot claim all hosted driver scheduling explained; validate original three fixed-budget tests and output.

sources.finding: Frozen shard #2: fixed photo/render handoff now finishes, but hosted frames arrive with 1–4-second presentation gaps and all three cold/retained input paths run through budgets.
Use existing Three ImageBitmapLoader and its native option/abort handling; configure standard browser resize and source orientation.
Installed pinned useTexture calls gl.initTexture even when parent Group is hidden; use the established eager route unchanged for GPU hardware, not for hidden software sky.
The browser-native ImageBitmap resize/orientation options avoid a JS pixel loop, new runtime assets or a duplicate renderer.
Existing exact independent PlanetScene world fallback and same retained parent scene; the panorama is only decoration and separate from surface paint/target gating.

search_ladder.conclusion: Retain existing pinned renderer and world pipeline, its actual repaint authority, and older visual cold gates.
Reuse Three loader and renderer. The mounted hardware helper retains all original behavior; only software texture acquisition must stop blocking the primary world scene.
Use browser async image decode/resize and existing Three texture ownership; no custom image-processing renderer or newly sourced asset.
Keep the exact bundled asset, same equirectangular UV orientation/color/canvas sphere, device-bounded dimensions, and dispose only this component's texture/decode.

decision.rationale: Reuse installed browser ImageBitmapLoader, one existing renderer and the same art. Preserve native paint/coordinate and product thresholds; only add bounded optional device realization.
decision.fallback: When ImageBitmap is unavailable keep the existing loader. Fail closed on actual unchanged product-test regressions, not by relaxing budgets.
